scope: Complete HBQ crewHold, routeWaiting, refreshRoute and rearClear helper text; selected current CBE unload/mobility boundaries, not whole HBQ parity

findings.source: crewHold changes combat unload policy according to canMove; cargo remains separate. It also schedules forced reseating without repeating all original guards.
findings.disposition: Implement mobility-aware release of existing CBE retention leases; do not import forced seating or overwrite allowCrewInImmobile.

findings.source: routeWaiting protects HOLD, synchronized inactive trigger, timeout and nontrue condition near current waypoint.
findings.disposition: Current DrivingAssistStart has nativeWaiting and stricter plain-MOVE recoveryOrderFree. No additional route controller or arbitrary condition evaluation needed.

findings.intent: Wake native route after script interruption
findings.source: refreshRoute replaces waypoint or directly moves effective commander; also resets crew features, engine and follow orders.
findings.disposition: Retain intent but reject blanket feature resets and authored waypoint replacement. Current CBE uses finite exact route/native receipts; physical forward handback remains unverified.

findings.source: rearClear checks rear entities and six solid rays.
findings.disposition: CBE DrivingRearClear has bounded hull/support/relative velocity checks. This review inspected selected current portions, not complete new geometry acceptance.

implementation.behaviour: Disabled carriers release only unchanged matching unload leases; convoy reconciles registered disabled carriers before mobile filtering/all-immobile early return. Existing external-value conflict refusal remains before disabled release. No forced dismount, seat move, feature reset or damage protection.
implementation.validation: 1477 tests, HEMTT/FSM/full build and independent verification passed
